A plugin key: a tag item, written plugin:{plugin name}:TAG_{item name}, or an expression the plugin declares, written plugin:{plugin name}:EXP_{expression name}. As an itemName a tag item shows the plugin's value, or the item's default. As a condition key or an "&key" either reads what the plugin last pushed for the aircraft, else its default: a tag item's registered default, an expression's declared one. It reads empty while the plugin is not loaded and on a row that is no aircraft. A boolean expression reads "1" or "0".
Logical AND operator
Logical OR operator
Logical NOT operator: true when none of the listed conditions is true
Logical NOT EMPTY operator
Logical IS EMPTY operator
[]: the condition that always holds, as an absent one does where absence applies.

items.description: The time zone the times are in: an IANA id such as Europe/London, or UTC.

from.description: The first day a window may start: MMDD for a period every year, YYMMDD for a single one.

to.description: The last day a window may start, in the same form as from. A yearly period may run over the new year.

days.description: The weekdays a window may start on, 1 Monday to 7 Sunday, or 0 to run from start on the first day to end on the last.

end.description: HH:MM, up to 24:00. At or before start, the window ends on the following day.

anyOf.description: A time window, TopSky's activation schedule: ["within", zone, {from, to, days, start, end}]. A window that passes midnight stays until its end on the following day.

width.description: Column width in pixels. Ignored when widthChars is set.

widthChars.description: Column width in characters, measured at the column's own font and size. Overrides width. Prefer this: a pixel width means a different number of visible characters at every body text size.

header.description: This column's header, overriding the list-wide header style. A header shows a fixed label, so it resolves no expression and carries no click action beyond the sort toggle.

text.description: Shown instead of the column name. The name stays the sort key either way.

textAlign.description: Horizontal alignment of the header label within the column.

color.description: RGB colour array [r,g,b] or [r,g,b,a]. Overrides the sorted-column highlight for this header.

backgroundColor.description: RGB colour array [r,g,b] or [r,g,b,a] painted behind the header label.

fontSize.description: Overrides the list style headerTextSize for this column.

fontWeight.description: bold or light; anything else renders normal.

fontFamily.description: Overrides the list face for this header.

itemName.description: The name of the item to be displayed.

truncate.description: An array of two numbers representing the start and end index of the substring to be displayed.

format.description: Transition-altitude presentation for this item. "altitude" uses the system's altitudeFormat and picks the band from the item's own value; "flightLevel" always uses the above-transition band, for values that are always a level. An object overrides the system default inline. Explicit truncate, padWithZeroLeft, prefix or suffix on this item override the matching part.

placeholder.description: Text displayed when the item is empty or equal to 0. Takes every form prefix takes: plain text, a "=rule" or "&key" reference, or an array of them tried in order.

prefix.description: A prefix string to be displayed before the item, it can also be an expression rule.

suffix.description: A suffix string to be displayed after the item, it can also be an expression rule.

mapping.description: A mapping object to map item values to display values, this forces the display value based on the item value you set.

padWithZeroLeft.description: A number to pad the item value with leading zeros.

padWithZeroRight.description: A number to pad the item value with trailing zeros.

fontSize.description: Font size of the itemm can also be an expression rule.

fontWeight.description: Font weight of the item, can also be an expression rule.

fontFamily.description: Font family of the item. Also takes a "=rule" or "&key" reference, or an array of them tried in order, read for each aircraft.

textAlign.description: Text alignment of the item, can be left, center or right.

lineHeight.description: Line height of the item, can also be an expression rule.

anyOf.description: RGB color array [r,g,b]
RGBA color array [r,g,b,a]
RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)

color.description: Color of the item (in RGBA), can also be an expression rule. In a YAML file a literal block (|) of =rule lines, one per line, is read as this array.

applyWhen.description: Shows the item only while this condition holds, the same expression shape as a variant's applyWhen; otherwise the cell is empty and a row with no shown item collapses. A condition the parser cannot read never holds and hides the item, as a variant's does. NOVA's flashing ALERT line is a text item with ["==", "rimcasStage", "2"] on every label.

blinkColor.description: Blink color of the item (in RGBA), can also be an expression rule.

backgroundBlinkColor.description: Background color of the item on the blink phase (in RGBA).

backgroundColor.description: Background color of the item (in RGBA), can also be an expression rule. In a YAML file a literal block (|) of =rule lines, one per line, is read as this array.

padding.description: Radar-label only: room between a tag item's text and the edge of its background. A list cell lays out through the list's own column width, so this does nothing here.

separatorBefore.description: Whether add a blank padding the item.

showPlusMinus.description: Whether to show a plus/minus sign before the item if the item is a number. Also takes a "=rule" or "&key" reference, or an array of them tried in order, read for each aircraft. A rule's value or a key that reads 1 or true turns it on, 0 or false off.

value.description: A static value or expression to be displayed instead of the item if the item name is set to text. In a YAML file a literal block (|) of =rule lines, one per line, is read as this array.

Opens the combined COPN/COPX coordination list, whichever side you hold.

Opens the release list: what the controller taking this flight next may do before the transfer of control point (turn, climb, descent, each optionally bounded by a level). Only for a flight you hold, and only on a system whose policy.json enables releases.
Asks whoever has this flight to put it on your frequency, as an OLDI ROF. No popup; a toast says whether it went.

Opens the next-sector list for a flight you hold whose exit is through a sector's floor or ceiling, where the exit level alone cannot say which sector takes it. Names the sector; the server re-sequences on it. On a lateral exit a toast says the geometry decides.

Opens the point-out list for a flight you hold: every other controller online. Sends an OLDI PNT to a controller who has advertised OLDI and the legacy #PC CCP:PT point-out to anyone else; neither has a reply, and the receiving screen shows it for the policy's hold time. Only on a system whose policy.json enables point-outs.

Toggles a quick-look pin on this aircraft for the radar view that was clicked: while pinned it is shown regardless of the view's upper and lower altitude filters (the GND, PRIM and VFR filters still apply). Click again to unpin. Per view, never saved.
Acknowledge the highest safety net alert on this aircraft: the repeat sound stops and alertAcknowledged reads 1, the colour stays. A change of kind or severity re-arms it. Available to an observer.
Silence safety net sounds for this session, or restore them. Reads back as alertsMuted, so the label can say it is silenced. Available to an observer.

Take this aircraft out of every client-side safety net until it is clicked again, or restore it: STCA, RAM, AIW and AFDAS all skip it, the emergency squawk net never does. The controller's per-aircraft twin of policy.json safetyNets.exclude; it never turns a net off for anyone else. Available to an observer.

Show or hide this aircraft's TCT legs for the session: both predicted paths of its earliest tactical conflict to the closest point, in mapstyle tctLeg colours, with the minimum and the time to it on the other aircraft's leg. While shown, the pair's speed vectors and route legs hide unless either has an STCA. Available to an observer.

Set the missed approach manual alert on this aircraft, or clear it when it is the one already set; one manual alert stands at a time, so this replaces another. Shared with every controller over the scratchpad and read back as manualAlert. Needs a track this controller may edit.

Set the inbound estimate manual alert on this aircraft, or clear it when it is the one already set; one manual alert stands at a time, so this replaces another. Shared with every controller over the scratchpad and read back as manualAlert. Needs a track this controller may edit.

Set the irregular manual alert on this aircraft, or clear it when it is the one already set; one manual alert stands at a time, so this replaces another. Shared with every controller over the scratchpad and read back as manualAlert. Needs a track this controller may edit.

leftClick.description: The action to be performed when the item is left-clicked

rightClick.description: The action to be performed when the item is right-clicked

doubleClick.description: The action to be performed when the item is double-clicked, on a radar label as well as in a list.

middleClick.description: The action to be performed when the item is middle-clicked.

leftDrag.description: Radar-label only: dragging from a tag item starts a drawing tool. A list column has nothing to drag from, so this does nothing here.

textWeight.description: Fine stroke weight. Negative thins the strokes, positive thickens them, 0 is the font's own weight. Overrides fontWeight. Also takes a "=rule" or "&key" reference, or an array of them tried in order, read for each aircraft.

textSharpness.description: Edge hardness. 0 keeps the rasteriser's own antialiasing, 1 gives a near-binary edge. A negative textWeight with some sharpness gives a thin, crisp look. Also takes a "=rule" or "&key" reference, or an array of them tried in order, read for each aircraft.

toggleGroup.description: Names the runtime toggle this item belongs to; see labels.schema.json. A list column ignores it, the toggles blank radar tags only.

backdrop.description: What sits behind the list. 'transparent' lets the radar show through on every platform; 'blur' asks for a frosted backdrop and falls back to 'transparent' where the platform has none (macOS, Linux). Omitted, any headerOpacity or bodyOpacity below 1 still means 'transparent'.

rowColor.description: Colour of every cell in the row: an RGB or RGBA array, one =rule, or an array of =rule where the first that matches wins. In a YAML file a literal block (|) of =rule lines, one per line, is read as this array.

fontFamily.description: Font family for this list's column headers and cells. Bundled with the client: "Roboto Mono" (the default when this is absent), "Cascadia Mono", "Inter". A column whose tagItem sets its own style.fontFamily wins over this for that column. An unknown name falls back to Roboto Mono.

paddingLeft.description: Inset in DIP between the list frame and the first column. Without it a left-aligned first column sits against the border. The header bar and each row highlight still span the full frame; only their content moves in, and the window widens to keep every column visible.

paddingRight.description: Inset in DIP between the last column and the list frame. Separate from paddingLeft because the first and last columns usually carry opposite text alignments, so the optical gap they need is not the same.

altitudeFormat.description: How altitude-valued tag items render either side of the transition altitude. Declared once per system; items opt in with "format".

prefix.description: Text placed before the digits, e.g. "A" below the transition altitude.

suffix.description: Text placed after the digits, e.g. "00" to render full feet rather than hundreds.

digits.description: MINIMUM digit count of the value in hundreds of feet, zero-padded and never truncated. 2 renders 3000 as "30" and still renders 12000 as "120".

prefix.description: Text placed before the digits, e.g. "A" below the transition altitude.

suffix.description: Text placed after the digits, e.g. "00" to render full feet rather than hundreds.

digits.description: MINIMUM digit count of the value in hundreds of feet, zero-padded and never truncated. 2 renders 3000 as "30" and still renders 12000 as "120".
